description: Two audio signals combined by eight different operations at once, each with its own level in the mix.

params.text: How much of the two inputs bitwise ANDed together goes into the mix.
How much of the two inputs bitwise exclusive-ORed together goes into the mix.
How much of the two inputs bitwise ORed together goes into the mix.
How much of the smaller of the two inputs goes into the mix.
How much of the larger of the two inputs goes into the mix.
How much of the two inputs ring modulated together goes into the mix.
How much of the two inputs amplitude modulated together goes into the mix.
How much of the absolute difference between the two inputs goes into the mix.
Sets how the results are sent to the two outputs: up puts the whole mix on both, middle splits the operations between them, down sends a different pairing to each.

inputs.text: The first audio signal. With nothing patched here an internal sine is used instead.
The second audio signal. With nothing patched here an internal sine is used instead.

outputs.text: The mix of the selected operations, second output.
The mix of the selected operations, first output.

notes: Set Rack's sample rate to 96kHz before using this module. At any other rate it runs at the wrong speed, and a red bar appears across the bottom of the panel saying so.
The module makes a sound with nothing patched in, because each empty audio input is replaced by an internal sine.
